claim: A multi-part game is one game with one NXC patch: one colour set and at most 4 toggles for the whole game, each a byte difference from the default, each combination read back.

evidence.text: One .nxc holds the default build, one colour set and at most 4 toggles for the whole game; a set or toggle is the byte difference from the default, and make_nxc reads every combination back.
evidence.quote: (an .nxc has at most 4 toggles for the whole game; "Original pace" is the first).
